records.question: 每个品类里销量最高的商品分别是什么？
records.rewritten: 每个品类里销量最高的商品分别是什么？
records.statement:
SELECT 品类, 商品名称, 销量
FROM (
  SELECT p.category AS 品类,
         p.product_name AS 商品名称,
         SUM(o.quantity) AS 销量,
         ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY p.category ORDER BY SUM(o.quantity) DESC) AS rn
  FROM orders o
  JOIN products p ON o.product_id = p.product_id
  GROUP BY p.category, p.product_name
)
WHERE rn = 1
ORDER BY 销量 DESC
LIMIT 100
records.judge_detail: 列内容一致（列名或列顺序不同）
